value.rationale: The intrinsic Euclidean Löwner ellipsoid is a natural invariant of the book-graph symmetric edge polytope. The theorem exhibits an exact structural switch: after the third page, newly added extreme roots cease to be ellipsoid contacts, and adding an entire hub edge to K2,m leaves the minimum enclosing ellipsoid unchanged for all m>=3 despite strict containment. The explicit unique ellipsoid, semiaxis eigenspaces, volume and m=2 strict-volume ratio furnish geometric content unavailable from lattice equivalence or facet enumerations.
